own_solution.law: Weak-field anomalous Zeeman effect; outermost-component separation dE = (g_P + g_S) mu_B B; d(lambda) = lambda^2 dE / hc.
assumptions: Linear Zeeman regime with J-level g-factors

T63F3.regime: Weak-field regime: Zeeman splittings (~1e-4 eV) << fine-structure splitting; holds for 0.0018, 0.0036, 0.004 eV.
